title: The generator-facing timeline surface is discoverable through the design-time capability manifest

installed_sdk.rationale: The bound headers already install: PulpInstallRules.cmake lists timeline in the per-subsystem install(DIRECTORY ...) loop over _pulp_sdk_header_subsystems, so an embedding host includes the typed source seam rather than re-declaring it. The delivery stays pending its installed-consumer proof.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: Publishing capability rows adds no Timeline CLI operation; the CLI surface is unchanged by this packet.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: Publishing capability rows adds no offline Timeline MCP operation.

live_product_control.rationale: Runtime operation metadata is broker authority and stays outside the design-time manifest by construction, so nobody owes a control row for these keys.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The generated manifest publishes five timeline keys with typed bindings and operational probes: the authored groove model, the harmonic and intensity context lanes, the compile-context subscription vocabulary, and the seeded per-note gate. The domain reports not_inventoried because the editing, persistence, schema and interchange headers are deliberately unclassified rather than claimed.
